content: Supabase new-project wizard requires manually selecting a Region (no auto-detect) — pick closest to Render's deployed region (Render free tier defaults to Oregon, US West) to minimize latency; Postgres cannot be moved cross-region later, only export/reimport. Free tier: up to 2 active projects, no credit card required, commercial use IS allowed on free tier. Gotchas: project auto-pauses after 7 days DB inactivity (not dashboard visits); 500MB DB, 5GB egress/month limits are easy to hit with careless client-side queries.
